strings.Add memories to it with `uteke remember: 用 `uteke remember "<your text>" --room <room> --author <name>` 新增記憶到房間。
strings.Create a room with `uteke room create <r: 用 `uteke room create <room>` 建立房間。
strings.Download to /tmp/uteke-install.sh first,: 先下載到 /tmp/uteke-install.sh 並閱讀，再執行 sh /tmp/uteke-install.sh
strings.Local-first memory engine that stores, r: 本機優先的記憶引擎，可離線為 AI 代理儲存、回想與搜尋記憶。
strings.RFC3339 timestamp e.g. uteke recall \"q\: RFC3339 時間戳記，例如 uteke recall "q" --at 2030-01-01T00:00:00Z
strings.Recall it as of a given time with `uteke: 用 `uteke recall "<query>" --at <timestamp>` 回溯指定時間點的記憶。
strings.Recall memories as of a point in time: 回溯特定時間點的記憶
strings.Recall memories at any point in time: 回想任一時間點的記憶
strings.Run `uteke remember \"<your text>\"` to: 執行 `uteke remember "<your text>"` 儲存你的第一筆記憶。
strings.Search memories by meaning and keywords: 依語意與關鍵字搜尋記憶
strings.Search the room with `uteke room recall: 用 `uteke room recall <room> "<query>"` 搜尋房間。
strings.Share memories across agents in rooms: 在房間中讓多個代理共享記憶
strings.Share memory across agents with Rooms: 透過 Rooms 跨代理共享記憶
strings.Store a memory with `uteke remember \"<y: 用 `uteke remember "<your text>"` 儲存一筆記憶。
strings.its check passed in the agent's box but: 其檢查在代理的環境中通過，但在全新環境中未再次通過
strings.recall memories by meaning and keyword: 依語意與關鍵字回想記憶
strings.share memories across agents in rooms: 在 room 中跨代理共享記憶
strings.uteke room create engineering (no --desc: uteke room create engineering（沒有 --description 旗標）
strings.uteke room recall engineering \"caching: uteke room recall engineering "caching decision"（room recall 子指令）
